name: Kagami Nakayama
source:
A first-year at Solana Academy. Kagami is usually quiet, and when she does talk she tends to use formal address and a carefully selected vocabulary. She often wears a scarf, even when it isn’t cold.

[From [url=https://jackkel-dragon.itch.io/eldritch-academy]itch.io[/url]]
